# mt2.ui.native

Display a native MT2 window with buttons, tabs, inputs, panels and PNG images.

```lua
mt2.ui.native(options: MT2NativeWindow): MT2NativeResult
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `MT2NativeWindow` | `Required` | Registered app ID, open state, dimensions and 1-80 native widgets. |

## Contract

- **Returns:** MT2NativeResult
- **Thread:** Render callback.
- **When to call:** Active render callback. Do not nest inside mt2.ui.window.
- **Effects:** Creates a game-owned window. Layout is fixed for this Lua instance; text and state may change. Send open=false to hide it.
- **Reload:** Owned UI registrations are replaced when the new Lua instance first renders; failed preparation retains the old instance.
- **Persistence:** Session-local. Store input values and open state in Lua.
- **Capabilities:** `ui`
- **Since:** 1.1.0
- **Stability:** experimental

## Errors

- Missing capability or inactive/staging owner raises a Lua error.
- Register ui.app first. Native dimensions must be 400-1100 by 300-640.
- Layout changes require a Lua reload; native plugins still require a restart.
- PNG paths must be package assets/*.png or owned `cache/<sha256>.png`; 1 MiB, 2048 pixels per dimension, 128 images per session.
- ready=false during a mode transition is a wait state, not a confirmed visible window.

## Example

This complete example is also available under `examples/native-app/main.lua` in the source and SDK documentation bundle. Native effects require the real game.

```lua
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
local open, name, message = false, "Modder", "Welcome to MT2!"

mt2.events.on("render", function()
    local app = mt2.ui.app({id="main", title="Hello native Lua"})
    if app.open_requested then open = true end
    if not open then return end
    local result = mt2.ui.native({id="main", open=open, width=560, height=320,
        widgets={
            {id="intro", type="text", x=20, y=20, width=430, height=42,
                size=22, text="Your first native Lua app"},
            {id="preview", type="image", x=470, y=20, width=64, height=64,
                path="assets/icon.png"},
            {id="name", type="input", x=20, y=80, width=320, height=34,
                value=name, max_bytes=128},
            {id="greet", type="button", x=360, y=80, width=180, height=34,
                text="Say hello"},
            {id="message", type="text", x=20, y=140, width=520, height=80,
                text=message}
        }})
    if not result.ready then return end
    name = result.values.name or name
    for _, id in ipairs(result.clicked) do
        if id == "greet" then message = "Hello, " .. name .. "!" end
    end
    open = result.open
end)
```
